verses.ar: يَا إِلَهَ ٱلنَّقَمَاتِ يَارَبُّ، يَا إِلَهَ ٱلنَّقَمَاتِ، أَشْرِقِ.
verses.kjv: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
verses.web: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

verses.ar: ٱرْتَفِعْ يَا دَيَّانَ ٱلْأَرْضِ. جَازِ صَنِيعَ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ.
verses.kjv: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.web: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

verses.ar: حَتَّى مَتَى ٱلْخُطَاةُ يَارَبُّ، حَتَّى مَتَى ٱلْخُطَاةُ يَشْمَتُونَ؟
verses.kjv: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.web: Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

verses.ar: يُبِقُّونَ، يَتَكَلَّمُونَ بِوَقَاحَةٍ. كُلُّ فَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ يَفْتَخِرُونَ.
verses.kjv: [How long] shall they utter [and] speak hard things? [and] all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.web: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

verses.ar: يَسْحَقُونَ شَعْبَكَ يَارَبُّ، وَيُذِلُّونَ مِيرَاثَكَ.
verses.kjv: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
verses.web: They break your people in pieces, Yahweh, and afflict your heritage.

verses.ar: يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلْأَرْمَلَةَ وَٱلْغَرِيبَ، وَيُمِيتُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ.
verses.kjv: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.web: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ: «ٱلرَّبُّ لَا يُبْصِرُ، وَإِلَهُ يَعْقُوبَ لَا يُلَاحِظُ».
verses.kjv: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard [it].
verses.web: They say, “Yah will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

verses.ar: اِفْهَمُوا أَيُّهَا ٱلْبُلَدَاءُ فِي ٱلشَّعْبِ، وَيَا جُهَلَاءُ مَتَى تَعْقِلُونَ؟
verses.kjv: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and [ye] fools, when will ye be wise?
verses.web: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

verses.ar: ٱلْغَارِسُ ٱلْأُذُنِ أَلَا يَسْمَعُ؟ ٱلصَّانِعُ ٱلْعَيْنَ أَلَا يُبْصِرُ؟
verses.kjv: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.web: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

verses.ar: ٱلْمُؤَدِّبُ ٱلْأُمَمَ أَلَا يُبَكِّتُ؟ ٱلْمُعَلِّمُ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ مَعْرِفَةً.
verses.kjv: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, [shall not he know]?
verses.web: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يَعْرِفُ أَفْكَارَ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ أَنَّهَا بَاطِلَةٌ.
verses.kjv: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they [are] vanity.
verses.web: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلرَّجُلِ ٱلَّذِي تُؤَدِّبُهُ يَارَبُّ، وَتُعَلِّمُهُ مِنْ شَرِيعَتِكَ
verses.kjv: Blessed [is] the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
verses.web: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your law,

verses.ar: لِتُرِيحَهُ مِنْ أَيَّامِ ٱلشَّرِّ، حَتَّى تُحْفَرَ لِلشِّرِّيرِ حُفْرَةٌ.
verses.kjv: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.web: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ لَا يَرْفُضُ شَعْبَهُ، وَلَا يَتْرُكُ مِيرَاثَهُ.
verses.kjv: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.web: For Yahweh won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ إِلَى ٱلْعَدْلِ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْقَضَاءُ، وَعَلَى أَثَرِهِ كُلُّ مُسْتَقِيمِي ٱلْقُلُوبِ.
verses.kjv: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.web: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَقُومُ لِي عَلَى ٱلْمُسِيئِينَ؟ مَنْ يَقِفُ لِي ضِدَّ فَعَلَةِ ٱلْإِثْمِ؟
verses.kjv: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? [or] who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.web: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

verses.ar: لَوْلَا أَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ مُعِينِي، لَسَكَنَتْ نَفْسِي سَرِيعًا أَرْضَ ٱلسُّكُوتِ.
verses.kjv: Unless the LORD [had been] my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.web: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

verses.ar: إِذْ قُلْتُ: «قَدْ زَلَّتْ قَدَمِي» فَرَحْمَتُكَ يَارَبُّ تَعْضُدُنِي.
verses.kjv: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
verses.web: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.

verses.ar: عِنْدَ كَثْرَةِ هُمُومِي فِي دَاخِلِي، تَعْزِيَاتُكَ تُلَذِّذُ نَفْسِي.
verses.kjv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
verses.web: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

verses.ar: هَلْ يُعَاهِدُكَ كُرْسِيُّ ٱلْمَفَاسِدِ، ٱلْمُخْتَلِقُ إِثْمًا عَلَى فَرِيضَةٍ؟
verses.kjv: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.web: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

verses.ar: يَزْدَحِمُونَ عَلَى نَفْسِ ٱلصِّدِّيقِ، وَيَحْكُمُونَ عَلَى دَمٍ زَكِيٍّ.
verses.kjv: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.web: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.ar: فَكَانَ ٱلرَّبُّ لِي صَرْحًا، وَإِلَهِي صَخْرَةَ مَلْجَإِي.
verses.kjv: But the LORD is my defence; and my God [is] the rock of my refuge.
verses.web: But Yahweh has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

verses.ar: وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِمْ إِثْمَهُمْ، وَبِشَرِّهِمْ يُفْنِيهِمْ. يُفْنِيهِمُ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُنَا.
verses.kjv: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; [yea], the LORD our God shall cut them off.
verses.web: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. Yahweh, our God, will cut them off.
